# Issue:
If you use the Drone Camera with any of the Behaviour options enabled, you will notice that they don't work that great which each other and not how you would think they do.
**Smoothed:**
Turning on Smooth currently does nothing.
**Look-At-Me:**
When moving the drone, the WASD and Q/E work as if the camera would always be looking at you, but you can still move the view freely. It snaps back to looking at you after you let go of the Fly Camera button.
Basically if you enabled `Look-At-Me` and then fly around with the camera looking away from you, W will actually move you backwards, aka to the direction of your player.
**Auto Level:**
Similar to `Look-At-Me`, the controls will work as if the camera would always be levelled while the view behaves as if `Auto Level` is not turned on. It snaps back to being Auto Leveled once you let go of the Fly Camera button.
# Suggestion:
Adjust these modes to work better with the Drone Camera, here is how I think that could work:
**Smoothed:**
Just smooth out all the movements you do with it. Looking up / down and right / left should be smoothed, same as starting / stopping to move. It should basically just slowly speed up and down when ever you do any movement.
**Look-At-Me:**
The Camera View should always be locked to look at your player and you should only be able to use the WASD and Q/E
 buttons to move the camera around.
 
 **Auto Level:**
 The Camera View should not be able to be rotated up / down so only rotations to the left / right are possible.
 
 I think this would be the best way to handle the different Behaviour Modes, it would generally improve the camera experience a lot and would definitely also help with a later adoption VR of the Drone Camera
 
# Attachments:
Here is a short video of me explaining all the problems and my proposed solution: https://youtu.be/GDJePB_CU4Q
title: Drone Camera does not work great with the different Camera Behaviours
